kamloops.title: In Kelowna's election debates on homelessness, unhoused residents feel left out of the conversation
kamloops.description: Homelessness and public safety have emerged as defining issues in Kelowna's municipal election, but some people living unhoused in the city say many candidates are leaving those most affected out of the conversation.

prince-george.title: New anti-gang unit for northern B.C. launched in Prince George
prince-george.description: A new regional anti-gang unit for northern B.C. has officially launched in Prince George, announced during a press conference on Thursday.

prince-george.title: Northern B.C. city calls for end to provincial e-scooter pilot program
prince-george.description: Fort St. John is joining calls for B.C. to end its electric scooter pilot program, and roll out province-wide regulations and the funding to enforce them.

cariboo.title: 2 candidates vie to be Lytton's mayor 5 years after devastating fire
cariboo.description: Voters in Lytton, B.C., will choose between two current council members in the race for mayor.
